notes:
Summary: SMB sales enablement startup building a lightweight call-summary + follow-up task generator. Inbound via pricing/signup flow. They are self-serve first — want to try hosted API. Key asks: how PII is handled, retention windows, and auditability for compliance partners.

From discovery call:
- Product: automatic call summaries, highlight extraction, follow-up task creation, and simple lead-scoring heuristics. No heavy real-time latency needs (batch post-call summaries acceptable), but web UI needs <1s perceived time for preview snippets.
- Volumes: ~150k tokens/month initially, expected 2-3x growth in 6 months. Concurrency: ~25-40 agents calling summaries during weekday peaks.
- Model preference: open-models preferred for cost, but will consider Redwood-curated small/medium models if cost/loss tradeoff is clear.
- Security: public cloud deploy acceptable; they insist on SSO for admin users, audit logs for each API call, and KMS for customer keys. Legal asked specifically: "Can you provide redaction examples and a retention TTL we can show partners?"
- PII handling: prefer redaction at ingestion layer (regex + ML sensitive-entity masking) and also want model-output scrub option. Concern: logs and raw audio/text retention — want clear TTLs and ability to purge per-user.
- Quote from founder: "We need a straight answer on what stays on your systems and for how long — our partners will not onboard without it."
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; looking for predictable per-month costs rather than surprise token spikes. Interested in simple predict/cap rules and alerting.

Actions to take: prepare hosted-API FAQ focused on PII handling, a sample retention-config JSON, example redaction flow (ingest regex -> model call -> output scrub -> ephemeral KV cache), and a short pricing scenario for 150k tokens. Attach drive docs and push to Diego for technical call.

Short-term next: send docs + schedule technical Q&A (target week of 2024-11-18).
